paper.title: Trading off rewards and errors in multi-armed bandits

settings.name_in_paper: MAB tradeoff between rewards and estimation errors (objective f_w)
unmapped: Objective is not standard cumulative regret: regret R_n = f* - f_w(empirical allocation), where f_w(lambda) = w*sum_i lambda_i mu_i - (1-w)/K * sum_i sigma_i/sqrt(lambda_i) trades off average reward and sqrt(n)-scaled RMSE of arm mean estimates (active exploration)
Tradeoff weight w in (0,1) is given to the learner
Assumption 1: optimal allocation lies in restricted simplex, min_i lambda*_i >= lambda_min (lambda_min known to algorithm)
settings.definition_quote: We consider a MAB of $K$ arms with distributions $\{\nu_i\}_{i=1}^K$, each characterized by mean $\mu_i$ and variance~$\sigma_i^2$. For technical convenience, we consider distributions with bounded support in $[0,1]$. ... We define its regret w.r.t.\ the value of the optimal allocation as $R_n(\wt{\blambda}_n) = f^* - f_w(\wt{\blambda}_n; \{\nu_i\}_i)$.

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Under Asm.~\ref{asm:simplex}, \forcing with a parameter $\eta\leq 21$ and a simplex $\wb{\D}_K$ restricted to $\lambda_{\min}$ suffers a regret R_n \leq 1 if n \leq n_0 ... with probability $1-\delta$ ... n_0 = K(K\eta^2 + \eta\sqrt{K} + 1)

results.notes: Trivial first-phase branch. Regret is f* - f_w(empirical allocation), a normalized (non-cumulative) quantity, hence quantity 'other'.

symbols.beta_f: smoothness of f_w on restricted simplex: 3(1-w)sigma_max/(4K lambda_min^{5/2})
symbols.lambda_min: lower bound on allocation components defining the restricted simplex
symbols.n_2: C K^10 log^2(1/delta_n) / ((lambda*_min)^8 alpha^4 lambda_min^2), C numerical constant

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: 43 K^{5/2} \frac{\beta}{\alpha} \sqrt{\frac{\log(2/\delta_n)}{\eta\lambda_{\min}}} n^{-1/4} if n_0 < n \leq n_2 ... with probability $1-\delta$ (where $\delta_n = \delta/(4Kn(n+1))$)

results.notes: delta_n substituted: log(2/delta_n)=log(8Kn(n+1)/delta). Appendix states n_2 with lambda_min^4 rather than lambda_min^2 (inconsistency).

symbols.beta_f: smoothness of f_w on restricted simplex: 3(1-w)sigma_max/(4K lambda_min^{5/2})
symbols.lambda_min: lower bound on allocation components defining the restricted simplex
symbols.lambda_min_star: smallest component of the optimal allocation
symbols.n_2: C K^10 log^2(1/delta_n) / ((lambda*_min)^8 alpha^4 lambda_min^2), C numerical constant

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: 153 K^{5/2} \frac{\beta}{\alpha} \sqrt{\frac{\log(2/\delta_n)}{\lambda_{\min}\lambda_{\min}^*}}n^{-1/2} if n > n_2, with probability $1-\delta$ (where $\delta_n = \delta/(4Kn(n+1))$)

results.notes: Asymptotic O~(n^{-1/2}) rate on the normalized tradeoff regret.
